scientific.integrity: The primary open full text was inspected at model (2), the reproduction number, Theorem 3.1, and the Lyapunov derivative used in its proof; the pages containing the theorem and derivative were visually inspected. The equality case is reconstructed by a LaSalle invariant-set argument, and the characteristic equation verifies that the endpoint has a simple zero root. The bundled checker replays only finite algebraic identities. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result closes only the infection-free threshold at the critical value. It does not claim exponential convergence at the nonhyperbolic endpoint, does not reanalyze the supercritical endemic equilibrium, and does not modify the source numerical simulations.

title: The infection-free state remains globally stable at the critical threshold in a recruited-immune delay virus model
